services.hint: Drag each purpose onto the service that exists to do it.

svc-001.label: Auto-generate a caption and tags for an uploaded product photo
svc-001.why: Azure AI Vision's Image Analysis feature extracts captions, tags, and objects directly from images.

svc-002.label: Turn a recorded customer-support call into a written transcript
svc-002.why: Azure AI Speech's speech-to-text recognition converts spoken audio into text.

svc-003.label: Decide whether hundreds of product reviews are positive or negative
svc-003.why: Azure AI Language's sentiment analysis scores text as positive, negative, neutral, or mixed.

svc-004.label: Translate an incoming support ticket from Japanese into English
svc-004.why: Azure AI Translator performs text translation across dozens of languages in real time.

svc-005.label: Pull the vendor name, invoice number, and total from a scanned invoice
svc-005.why: Its prebuilt invoice model deterministically extracts known fields from standard form types like invoices and receipts.

svc-006.label: Describe the fields you want in plain language and get structured JSON back from a mix of documents, photos, and call recordings
svc-006.why: Content Understanding lets you define an analyzer in natural language and reasons over multimodal input to return structured JSON, unlike Document Intelligence's fixed prebuilt forms.

svc-007.label: Train a model to spot one specific defect on your factory's assembly-line images
svc-007.why: Custom Vision lets you train an image classifier or object detector on your own labeled images for a narrow, custom task.

svc-008.label: Verify a person's identity by comparing a selfie against their ID photo
svc-008.why: Azure AI Face provides face detection, verification, and liveness-check capabilities for identity scenarios.

svc-009.label: Automatically block hateful or violent text before it reaches app users
svc-009.why: Content Safety analyzes text and images for harmful-content categories and severity, then flags or blocks it.

svc-010.label: Spot an unusual spike in a sensor's time-series readings
svc-010.why: Anomaly Detector applies time-series analysis to flag data points that deviate from expected patterns.

svc-011.label: Let employees run natural-language search across thousands of internal documents
svc-011.why: Azure AI Search indexes and enriches content so users can query it with keyword and semantic search.

svc-012.label: Extract keywords, faces, and scene changes from an uploaded training video
svc-012.why: Video Indexer analyzes recorded video and audio to surface faces, keywords, topics, and scenes.

svc-013.label: Deploy GPT-4o inside your own Azure tenant to draft customer-support replies
svc-013.why: Azure OpenAI Service hosts OpenAI's models, like GPT-4o, as an enterprise Azure resource with your own deployment, quota, and content filters.

svc-014.label: One place to deploy a model, build an agent, and evaluate it before shipping
svc-014.why: Microsoft Foundry is the unified platform combining the model catalog, portal, SDK, and Agent Service for building and deploying AI solutions.

svc-015.label: Give a model file search, code interpreter, and function-calling tools so it can act across multiple turns
svc-015.why: Foundry Agent Service builds persistent agents combining a model, instructions, tools, and threads for multi-step, stateful tasks, not a single stateless chat call.

svc-016.label: Train, track, and manage a classic ML model through a full experiment pipeline
svc-016.why: Azure Machine Learning is Microsoft's dedicated platform for traditional ML model training, tracking, and MLOps, distinct from Foundry's generative-AI focus.
